recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-7230 unless the OO work group later decides to change the example's method coding separately from this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-7230 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for the DSTU1 Observation f206 staphylococcus example. It asked that the blood culture Observation.code use LOINC 600-7 with display "Bacteria identified in Blood by Culture" instead of using only SNOMED CT 104177005 as the observation code.
initial_application: Git commit 474be19befc8b8882da2b23a826dd0e2106a1538, whose message explicitly listed 7230, changed source/observation/observation-example-f206-staphylococcus.xml so Observation.code contains a local Acme Labs coding plus the requested LOINC 600-7 coding and display. Later commits changed formatting or surrounding terminology details without removing that LOINC coding.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and the f206 staphylococcus example is linked from source/observation/observation-examples-header.xml. The remaining SNOMED CT 104177005 coding is under Observation.method, not the sole Observation.code, so it does not conflict with the Jira request. Jira term search found only FHIR-7230 for the exact example/code issue, and corrected Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative XML already carries system http://loinc.org, code 600-7, and display "Bacteria identified in Blood by Culture" in Observation.code for the active f206 example.
